docs.title: City Transit — Lost and Found
docs.body: Items found on city buses and trams are kept at the Transit Lost and Found office at Gare Centrale for 60 days. To claim an item, you must describe it and show photo identification. Office hours: Monday–Friday, 8 A.M.–6 P.M. Items not claimed after 60 days are donated to local charities. You can also report a lost item online at citytransit.fr/lost.

questions.prompt: What must people do to claim an item?
options: Describe the item and show identification
questions.evidence: you must describe it and show photo identification
questions.explanation: Il faut décrire l'objet et présenter une pièce d'identité avec photo.

questions.prompt: What happens to items that are not claimed?
questions.evidence: are donated to local charities
questions.explanation: Après 60 jours, les objets non réclamés sont donnés à des associations.

questions.evidence: Mention this ad to receive 10% off

sets.title: E-mail d'une cliente à une agence

docs.subject: Spring campaign
docs.body:
Hi Theo,

Thank you for sending the first designs for our spring campaign. Our team was impressed by the photography, especially the outdoor shots.

However, we have two concerns. First, the product names are hard to read on the smaller posters. Second, our new eco-friendly packaging, which is the main focus of the campaign, doesn't appear in any of the images.

Could your team send revised versions by Thursday? Our board meets on Friday, and I'd like to present the final designs then.

Best,
Rachel

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of the e-mail?
options: To request changes to some designs
questions.evidence: Could your team send revised versions by Thursday?
questions.explanation: Après des compliments, elle demande des modifications des visuels.
questions.takeaway: However introduit souvent le vrai message.

questions.prompt: What does Ms. Moore say about the new packaging?
options: It is not shown in the designs.
It has not been produced yet.
questions.evidence: doesn't appear in any of the images
questions.explanation: Le nouvel emballage, au cœur de la campagne, n'apparaît sur aucune image.
questions.traps: « Hard to read » concerne les noms des produits.

questions.prompt: Why does Ms. Moore need the revisions by Thursday?
options: She will present them at a meeting the next day.
The posters will be printed on Friday.
questions.evidence: Our board meets on Friday
questions.explanation: Le conseil se réunit vendredi et elle veut y présenter les visuels définitifs.

docs.title: Regional Airport to Build New Terminal
docs.body:
Saint-Exupéry Regional Airport will begin construction on a new terminal this autumn. The €120 million project will increase the airport's capacity from four million to six million passengers per year. [1]

The new terminal will include twelve additional gates, a larger security area, and a direct connection to the tram line, which currently stops a ten-minute walk from the existing terminal. [2]

Airport director Claire Faure said the expansion was necessary because several airlines had asked to add routes but could not be accommodated. [3] Construction is expected to be completed in 2029. [4]

questions.prompt: What is the article mainly about?
questions.evidence: will begin construction on a new terminal
questions.explanation: L'article présente la construction d'un nouveau terminal.

questions.prompt: What is indicated about the tram line?
options: It does not currently reach the terminal directly.
It will be closed during construction.
questions.evidence: currently stops a ten-minute walk from the existing terminal
questions.explanation: Le tram s'arrête aujourd'hui à dix minutes à pied du terminal : il n'y arrive pas directement.

questions.prompt: In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong? "Two of these carriers plan to offer flights to North Africa."
questions.explanation: « These carriers » reprend « several airlines » qui voulaient ajouter des lignes, juste avant [3].

docs.title: École Supérieure de Commerce de Rennes — Alumni Relations
docs.subtitle: To: Ms. Hélène Vasseur
docs.body:
Dear Ms. Vasseur,

As a graduate of the École Supérieure de Commerce de Rennes, you are invited to join our new alumni mentoring program, which pairs experienced professionals with final-year students. Mentors meet their students online or in person about once a month during the academic year.

Last year, 85 percent of students in our pilot program found a job within six months of graduating. Many said their mentor's advice was a key factor.

If you are interested, please complete the short form on our website by 15 September. No previous mentoring experience is necessary; a two-hour training session will be provided.

Sincerely,
Alumni Relations Office

questions.prompt: Why was the letter sent?
options: To recruit volunteers for a program
To invite Ms. Vasseur to a reunion
questions.evidence: you are invited to join our new alumni mentoring program
questions.explanation: La lettre invite une ancienne élève à devenir mentor.

questions.prompt: What is suggested about the mentoring program?
options: It is only for engineering students.
questions.evidence: in our pilot program
questions.explanation: Un programme pilote a eu lieu l'an dernier : le dispositif a déjà été testé.

questions.prompt: What is NOT required of mentors?
options: Meeting students about once a month
Being a graduate of the school
questions.explanation: La lettre précise qu'aucune expérience préalable n'est nécessaire ; formulaire, rencontres mensuelles et diplôme de l'école sont attendus.

docs.title: Bergen Introduces Congestion Charge
docs.body:
Starting next January, drivers entering the center of Bergen between 7 A.M. and 6 P.M. on weekdays will pay a daily charge of 80 kroner. The city hopes the fee will reduce traffic by 20 percent and improve air quality. [1]

Residents of the zone will receive a 50 percent discount, and electric vehicles will be exempt until 2028. [2] Revenue from the charge will be used to expand bus services and build new bicycle lanes.

Local business owners have expressed mixed reactions. [3] Some worry that customers will choose shopping centers outside the city instead. Others believe that fewer cars will make the center more pleasant to visit. [4]

questions.prompt: What is the main goal of the charge?
options: To build a new shopping center
To reduce traffic in the city center
questions.evidence: The city hopes the fee will reduce traffic by 20 percent
questions.explanation: La ville veut réduire la circulation et améliorer la qualité de l'air.

questions.prompt: The word "exempt" in paragraph 2, line 1, is closest in meaning to
questions.evidence: electric vehicles will be exempt until 2028
questions.explanation: Les véhicules électriques seront exemptés, c'est-à-dire dispensés de payer.

questions.prompt: How will the money collected be used?
options: To improve buses and cycling infrastructure
questions.evidence: to expand bus services and build new bicycle lanes
questions.explanation: Les recettes financeront plus de bus et de nouvelles pistes cyclables.

questions.prompt: In which of the positions marked [1], [2], [3], and [4] does the following sentence best belong? "A survey of shops in the area found that opinions were almost evenly divided."
questions.explanation: La phrase illustre les « réactions partagées » des commerçants annoncées juste avant [3], puis le texte détaille les deux camps.
questions.takeaway: Evenly divided = partagé à parts égales.

docs.subject: Service interruption on 17 November
docs.body:
Dear customer,

On 17 November, between 2:10 P.M. and 5:45 P.M. (Paris time), some customers were unable to access their files on Cloudnest. The problem was caused by a hardware failure in one of our data centers in Frankfurt. No data was lost, and all services have been fully restored.

We sincerely apologize for the inconvenience. As a gesture of goodwill, all customers on paid plans will receive one month of service free of charge, which will appear automatically on your next invoice.

To reduce the risk of similar problems, we are adding a backup data center in Amsterdam, which will be operational by February.

Cloudnest Support

questions.prompt: What is the purpose of the e-mail?
questions.evidence: some customers were unable to access their files on Cloudnest
questions.explanation: Le mail explique une panne de service survenue la veille.

questions.prompt: What caused the problem?
questions.evidence: caused by a hardware failure
questions.explanation: La panne venait d'une défaillance matérielle dans un centre de données.

questions.prompt: What will customers on paid plans receive?
questions.evidence: will receive one month of service free of charge
questions.explanation: Les clients payants recevront un mois gratuit.

questions.prompt: What is indicated about the Amsterdam data center?
options: It has replaced the Frankfurt center.
It is not yet in operation.
questions.evidence: which will be operational by February
questions.explanation: Il ne sera opérationnel qu'en février : il ne fonctionne pas encore.

docs.title: Lingo Partners — Translation Rates
docs.note: Minimum charge: €60 per order. 10% discount on orders over 10,000 words.

docs.from: Sara Haddad, Marketing Manager, Belle Maison
docs.subject: Translation request
docs.body:
Hello,

We need our 6,000-word product catalog translated from French into English. We are launching in the UK on 15 March and need the translation by Friday, 6 March, at the latest. The text is not a legal document. Could you confirm that you can meet this deadline?

Sara Haddad

questions.prompt: What is Belle Maison planning to do?
questions.evidence: We are launching in the UK on 15 March
questions.explanation: L'entreprise se lance au Royaume-Uni : un nouveau marché.
questions.takeaway: Launch in a country = se lancer dans un pays.

questions.prompt: Which service will Ms. Haddad most likely need?
questions.explanation: Du lundi 2 au vendredi 6 mars, il y a quatre jours ouvrés : la traduction standard (5 jours) est trop lente, l'express (2 jours) convient.
questions.traps: La traduction certifiée concerne les documents juridiques, ce que le catalogue n'est pas.

questions.prompt: How much will the translation most likely cost?
questions.explanation: 6 000 mots × 0,18 € = 1 080 €. La remise de 10 % ne s'applique qu'au-delà de 10 000 mots.
questions.takeaway: Vérifie si les remises s'appliquent vraiment.

questions.prompt: What is indicated about the catalog?
questions.evidence: The text is not a legal document.
questions.explanation: Ce n'est pas un document juridique : aucune traduction certifiée n'est nécessaire.

questions.prompt: What does Ms. Haddad ask Lingo Partners to do?
options: Confirm that they can meet a deadline
questions.evidence: Could you confirm that you can meet this deadline?
questions.explanation: Elle demande de confirmer que le délai pourra être tenu.
questions.takeaway: Meet a deadline = respecter un délai.

docs.title: Kelvin Systems — Professional Development Fund (per employee, per year)

docs.subject: Conference request
docs.body:
Hi Laura,

I'd like to attend the European Cloud Summit in Amsterdam on 28–29 April. The registration fee is €950, and the train and hotel would cost about €400. I joined Kelvin four years ago and haven't used any of my development budget this year. Could you approve the request this week?

Groups of 15 or more receive a 20% discount and must book at least one week in advance. Tours end in our shop, where visitors can taste and buy our chocolates. For safety reasons, visitors must wear closed shoes.

Thank you for your booking request. We are happy to confirm your group's visit on 14 November at 10 A.M. Our tour route is fully accessible, and an elevator is available between floors. Please remind your students to wear closed shoes. Payment can be made on arrival.

Maison Chocolat Visitor Services

It was made at least a week in advance.

sets.title: Notes de frais : annonce, FAQ, e-mail

docs.title: MEMO — Verlo Group Finance Department
docs.body: Starting 1 March, all expense claims at Verlo Group must be submitted through the new SpendWise app. Paper claims will no longer be accepted. Claims are reimbursed within ten working days of approval. Training videos are available on the intranet.

docs.title: SpendWise — Frequently Asked Questions
rows: Can I submit claims from my phone?
Yes. Photograph your receipts in the app.
What is the deadline for submitting a claim?
Your direct manager. Claims over €1,000 also require approval from Finance.
What if I lose a receipt?
Complete a missing-receipt declaration in the app.

docs.subject: Conference expenses
docs.body:
Hello,

I attended a conference in Berlin on 3–4 March and spent €1,240 in total on registration, hotel, and flights. My manager approved the claim in SpendWise yesterday, but its status still says "pending." Is there a problem? Also, I can't find the receipt for one taxi ride. What should I do?

Tomasz Wolak

questions.prompt: What is the main purpose of the memo?
options: To introduce a new finance director
To announce a new way of submitting expense claims
questions.evidence: all expense claims at Verlo Group must be submitted through the new SpendWise app
questions.explanation: Le mémo annonce que les notes de frais passent par une nouvelle application.

questions.prompt: Why is Mr. Wolak's claim most likely still pending?
options: It also needs approval from Finance.
questions.explanation: Sa demande s'élève à 1 240 € : au-delà de 1 000 €, le service financier doit aussi l'approuver.
questions.takeaway: Applique le seuil de la FAQ au montant de l'e-mail.

questions.prompt: What should Mr. Wolak do about the missing taxi receipt?
options: Ask the taxi company for a copy
Fill out a declaration in the app
questions.explanation: La FAQ indique de remplir une déclaration de reçu manquant dans l'application.
questions.takeaway: Cherche la réponse à sa question dans la FAQ.

questions.prompt: What is indicated about Mr. Wolak's claim?
options: It was submitted within the required period.
questions.explanation: Dépense du 3–4 mars, demande approuvée le 9 mars : bien dans le délai de 60 jours.

questions.prompt: When can Mr. Wolak expect to be reimbursed?
options: Within ten working days after final approval
At the end of the year
questions.evidence: Claims are reimbursed within ten working days of approval.
questions.explanation: Le remboursement intervient dans les dix jours ouvrés suivant l'approbation.
questions.traps: 60 jours est le délai pour soumettre, pas pour être remboursé.

sets.title: Vélos en libre-service : tarifs, réclamation, réponse

docs.title: VeloCity Bike Share — Plans
rows: Unlimited 45-minute rides, 10 e-bike rides per month
docs.note: Extra time: €1 per additional 30 minutes. E-bikes: +€1 per ride (except included rides on the Annual plan).

docs.subject: Charge on my account
docs.body:
Hello,

I have a monthly plan. Yesterday I rode from the station to my office, and the ride took 50 minutes because of road closures. I was charged €1 for extra time, which I understand. But I was also charged €1 for an e-bike, although I'm sure I took a regular bike. Could you check?

Nora Lindqvist

docs.subject: RE: Charge on my account
docs.body:
Dear Ms. Lindqvist,

You are right: our records show that you used bike no. 4471, which is a regular bike. The e-bike charge was an error caused by a software update, and it has been refunded. Since you ride every day, you might also consider our annual plan, which would save you €60 per year and includes e-bike rides.

VeloCity Support

questions.prompt: Why did Ms. Lindqvist write to VeloCity?
questions.evidence: But I was also charged €1 for an e-bike
questions.explanation: Elle conteste un frais de vélo électrique alors qu'elle a pris un vélo classique.

questions.prompt: Why was Ms. Lindqvist charged for extra time?
options: She returned the bike late at night.
Her ride lasted longer than her plan includes.
questions.explanation: Son forfait mensuel inclut des trajets de 45 minutes ; le sien a duré 50 minutes.
questions.takeaway: Compare la durée réelle et la durée incluse.

questions.prompt: What caused the incorrect e-bike charge?
questions.evidence: caused by a software update
questions.explanation: Une mise à jour logicielle a provoqué l'erreur.
questions.takeaway: Software update = mise à jour logicielle.

questions.prompt: What is suggested about the annual plan?
options: It costs less than twelve monthly payments.
questions.explanation: Douze mois à 15 € = 180 € contre 120 € pour l'abonnement annuel : 60 € d'économie, comme l'indique le support.
questions.takeaway: Retrouve le calcul derrière un chiffre annoncé.

questions.prompt: What did VeloCity do about the e-bike charge?
questions.evidence: it has been refunded
questions.explanation: Le support reconnaît l'erreur et indique que les frais injustifiés ont été remboursés.
